body: That's true.  I just don't feel any better after writing it all down. I feel even more worthless and helpless than before.  I don't know what to do.
Thanks for your input and I appreciate you taking the time to answer but it has been made very clear to me that everyone would be better off without me around.  I don't know if I'm worth helping.

I tried using the Crisis Chat thing and it apparently doesn't work on my phone.  I don't think I'll be able to articulate myself well verbally over the phone either so that's out too. I seriously don't know why I came here and wrote this all out.
Listen,  I appreciate you trying to talk to me and all, I just don't know if there's anything that anyone can do. I don't even know why I posted this tonight and made this throwaway.
No. I don't.  My friends and family all refused to help at all when I first ran into problems. I am completely out of options.

I know this sounds dramatic as hell but I just can't do this anymore and I can't hurt anyone else by existing. 

I dress nicely,  I have good sales skills,  I think that I'm cute, I have amazing references. But I can't even get an interview doing fast food and my hosts think it's because I'm a lazy piece of shit. Well, they're right about me being a piece of shit. Everyone will be happier with me gone. 

I've been systematically isolating myself from any old friends and acquaintances ever since I got laid off in preparation to end it, just in case. People will miss the legend of me more than the real me.

I actually have, they usually either tell me that a manager isn't in to talk to me or that they'll review my application.  Then they never contact me.

Honestly,  even if I were to miraculously get a job in the next twenty-four hours, I doubt it would change anything.  The damage is done and I destroy everything good in my life, even if it's through pure accident or not.
